modules.note: whole cell assembled at build time: libcuflynx flat model of cell/generic_adaptive_cell/versions/fermenter merged into one component by aod_kernelgen.flatten (literal units restored from the sources)
modules.per_cell_inputs_note: inputs the game sets per cell (FermenterWorld, FermenterCell): glucose at the membrane (the same value for Glf and the PTS, ABC and GalP carriers), lactate and H+ at the membrane (H+ also as H_o), the motor, each trait target (membrane proteins as s_target, a share of the membrane ceiling, clamped per cell to the room the other proteins leave; the glycolytic enzymes and the flagella as m_target) and the growth, storage, repair and matrix controls; every other input is shared by the cells of a group (docs/plans/parallel-and-gpu.md)

modules.per_cell_inputs_note: the game makes a copy per gap between three cells (ExtracellularSpace) and sets its volume and the matrix the cells deliver; diffusion between volumes is the game's transport step with the extracellular_face law
